120320101.text: Many challenges still lie ahead for Inazuma, but I am prepared for them.

120320103.text: Abolishing the Sakoku Decree has a myriad of implications. It would be folly to say that it will be all positive, and there will be no negative repercussions.

120320104.text: For example, I can foresee the outside world posing a threat to Inazuma's businesses. These are the issues that I must work to solve.

120320105.text: Ei, you're thinking about this all so conscientiously. I've only got as far as wondering whether I'll be able to sell entrance tickets to the Grand Narukami Shrine in the future.

120320108.text: Makoto's gaze was always fixed on the people of Inazuma. I always assumed it was because... that was her duty.

120320109.text: But now I see that hers was a gaze full of delight and hope. It was not just a duty, but a joy, too. She loved humanity very dearly.

120320110.text: If people of the past deserved the gods' attention, then so do the people of the future.

120320111.text: Indeed. No longer will I ignore their passions and dreams.

120320113.text: To put it bluntly, it was constant torture with no end in sight.

120320114.text: Faced with an endless battle, I had to remain focused at all times. Had my concentration lapsed for but a moment, the Shogun's blade would have taken my life.

120320115.text: Safe to say, were it not for my previous experiences in combat, my skills would not have been up to the challenge. I would most certainly have been defeated.

120320116.text: And through it all, you also had your part to play.

120320118.text: Don't worry, I haven't forgotten. I will be sure to remind the Tenryou and Yashiro Commissions of their duties in this regard.

120320119.text: It's not only the monsters that I am worried about. I'm concerned about what else might escape from the Sacred Sakura.

120320120.text: That's a tough one, alright... There's plenty more besides memories held in the Ley Lines.

120320121.text: Since you clearly understand, perhaps you could think about making an effort, too.

120320123.text: Ahem! Yae Miko said nothing of the sort, and the Traveler has some nerve making up spurious claims about her while she is still present.

120320124.text: Some words are not to be passed on.

120320125.text: Trust me, you don't want to know the cost of betraying me. Just think of the things I said to you as our little secret. Understood?

120320127.text: Nothing. I suddenly want some fried tofu.
